name: Introduction to Programming
description: Fundamental programming concepts, procedural control flow, data abstractions, and problem-solving using Python.

name: Object-Oriented Design
description: Object-oriented programming principles, inheritance, polymorphism, design patterns, testing, and modern Java.

name: Web Development Fundamentals
description: Client-server architecture, semantic HTML5, modern CSS, JavaScript ES6+, and responsive UI development.

name: Data Structures
description: Linear and non-linear data structures: lists, stacks, queues, balanced search trees, heaps, hash tables, and graphs.

name: Full Stack Web Engineering
description: Modern frontend frameworks (React), REST and GraphQL APIs, asynchronous programming, and state management.

name: Computer Organization & Assembly
description: Machine-level representations of programs, memory hierarchy, instruction set architectures, and assembly language.

name: Algorithms & Complexity
description: Algorithm design paradigms: greedy, divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, network flow, and NP-completeness.

name: Database Management Systems
description: Relational algebra, SQL, indexing (B+ trees), query optimization, ACID transactions, and NoSQL / graph databases.

name: Operating Systems
description: Process management, virtual memory, threads, synchronization primitives, deadlock, and file system architectures.

name: Computer Networks
description: OSI & TCP/IP stack layers, routing protocols, transport reliability (TCP/UDP), socket programming, and CDN architectures.

name: Software Engineering & Architecture
description: Large-scale software design, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, design patterns, and agile methodologies.

name: Computer Security & Cryptography
description: Symmetric and public-key cryptography, TLS/SSL, authentication protocols, buffer overflows, and defensive engineering.

name: Machine Learning
description: Supervised & unsupervised learning, gradient descent, SVMs, decision trees, neural networks, and model evaluation.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Heuristic search, A* algorithm, game playing (Minimax, Alpha-Beta), constraint satisfaction, Markov decision processes.

name: Distributed Systems
description: Consensus protocols (Raft, Paxos), CAP theorem, distributed storage, MapReduce, and fault tolerance at scale.

name: Cloud Computing Infrastructure
description: Virtualization, container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), serverless compute, and distributed cloud design.

name: Deep Learning & Neural Architectures
description: Backpropagation, CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, attention mechanisms, Generative Adversarial Networks, and PyTorch.

name: Natural Language Processing
description: Statistical language models, tokenization, word embeddings, sequence-to-sequence, BERT, and Large Language Models.

name: Computer Vision
description: Image filtering, feature detection, object detection, segmentation, and 3D visual reconstruction.

name: Senior Capstone Design
description: Culminating team project designing, implementing, deploying, and presenting an industry-grade software product.

name: Advanced Algorithm Design
description: Graduate level algorithms: randomized algorithms, approximation algorithms, online algorithms, and spectral graph theory.

name: Advanced Distributed Systems & Consensus
description: Byzantine fault tolerance, distributed ledger technologies, peer-to-peer architectures, and geo-replicated data stores.

name: Calculus I
description: Limits, continuity, differentiation rules, optimization, Mean Value Theorem, and fundamental theorem of calculus.

name: Calculus II
description: Techniques of integration, improper integrals, infinite series, Taylor series, and parametric curves.

name: Multivariable Calculus
description: Partial derivatives, multiple integrals, vector calculus, line integrals, Green's Theorem, and Stokes' Theorem.

name: Linear Algebra
description: Vector spaces, linear transformations, matrices, determinants, eigenvalues/eigenvectors, and SVD decomposition.

name: Discrete Mathematics
description: Propositional logic, proofs, set theory, combinatorics, recurrence relations, and graph theory foundations.

name: Probability & Mathematical Statistics
description: Probability axioms, random variables, expectation, joint distributions, Central Limit Theorem, and hypothesis testing.

name: Numerical Methods & Optimization
description: Numerical linear algebra, root finding, convex optimization, quadratic programming, and gradient descent convergence.

name: Introduction to Data Science
description: Data lifecycle, exploratory data analysis, data wrangling with Pandas, data visualization, and ethical AI.

name: Data Wrangling & Pipelines
description: Data ingestion pipelines, schema validation, data cleaning, ETL processes, and stream processing with Apache Kafka.

name: Applied Statistical Modeling
description: Linear and logistic regression, ANOVA, generalized linear models, Bayesian inference, and time series forecasting.

name: Big Data Analytics with Spark
description: MapReduce paradigm, Apache Spark, distributed DataFrame operations, MLlib, and cluster resource management.

name: Data Visualization & Storytelling
description: Human visual perception, interactive dashboarding (D3.js, Tableau), visual hierarchy, and scientific communication.

name: Data Science Capstone
description: End-to-end data science project solving an enterprise challenge from data acquisition to production model deployment.

name: Introduction to Electrical Engineering
description: Basic circuits, Ohm's law, Kirchhoff's laws, AC/DC analysis, operational amplifiers, and laboratory measurement.

name: Digital Logic Design
description: Boolean algebra, combinational logic, Karnaugh maps, sequential circuits, flip-flops, FSMs, and FPGA programming in Verilog.

name: Microprocessor Systems & Architecture
description: ARM architecture, bus protocols, DMA, memory interfaces, peripheral control, and bare-metal firmware.

name: Embedded Systems & IoT
description: Real-time operating systems (FreeRTOS), sensor integration, wireless communication (BLE, Zigbee), and edge computing.

name: Signals & Systems
description: Continuous and discrete-time signals, Fourier transforms, Laplace transform, Z-transform, and digital filter design.

name: General Physics I: Mechanics
description: Newtonian mechanics, kinematics, work-energy theorem, momentum conservation, rotational dynamics, and gravitation.

name: General Physics II: Electromagnetism
description: Electrostatics, Gauss's Law, magnetic fields, Faraday's Law, Maxwell's equations, and electromagnetic waves.

name: Computational Physics
description: Numerical integration of differential equations, Monte Carlo simulations, N-body problems, and chaotic systems.
